reforms.description: A 10 percent investment tax credit on equipment and machinery was provided to promote structural changes in industry, effective until the end of FY 1980.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The tax credit incentivizes investment in equipment and machinery, which can enhance productivity and drive structural changes in the industry.
reforms.status_evidence: The investment tax credit remains effective until the end of FY 1980.
reforms.importance_rationale: The investment tax credit is a significant policy tool aimed at encouraging industrial investment, which can lead to broader economic benefits.
reforms.source_quote: A 10 per cent investment tax credit on equipment and machinery was provided to promote structural changes in industry.
